The '''Hidden Cave''' was a series of underground tunnels used as headquarters by the workers and slaves [[Rebellion in the Minboosa District|rebelling]] against the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] in the [[Minboosa District]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:TPB" />
